_note: The world's dials (writing-system-rune-spec §4). Every sigil binds to exactly one of these. 'dualValued' is Illumination and Thermal ONLY — for those, dim and dark are different pressures and one number can't say both. Everything is on a shared 0–100 scale so the preview speaks one language. PLACEHOLDER copy throughout.
